blurb: Guests fish in San Diego Bay, a natural deep water bay with hundreds of fish species. The bay is sheltered from offshore swells and suitable for all skill levels, including beginners and children. Fishing is fast and can yield 20-30 fish in a half day, with year-round good weather and views of Downtown San Diego.
